sentences.text: ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE SUNITA AGARWAL) Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and perused the record.
2. By means of the present petition, the petitioner seeks a writ in the nature of direction commanding the respondents to decide his representation dated 10.09.2020.

Further prayer made in the writ petition is to issue directions to the respondents to determine just, fair and adequate compensation for acquisition of the land forming part of Block No. 213 (old Survey Nos. 59/1, 59/4)
situated at Village Kudasan, Taluka and District Gandhinagar.

sentences.text: At the outset, we may record that the acquisition proceeding for acquisition of the land in question was conducted in the year 1966 with the issuance of the Notifications under Sections 4 and 6 of NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/1473/2025 ORDER DATED: 07/02/2025 undefined the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred to as the "Act, 1894").
The award under Section 11 of the Act, 1894 came to be passed on 01.03.1969.
The assertion made in the writ petition narrating the aforesaid dates, further is that the possession of the land in question has already been taken by the competent authority.
It is contended that the land in question was running in the name of the petitioner as an occupant at the time of acquisition of the land in question.
4. Taking note this contention, looking to the age of the petitioner herein as indicated in the array of parties, it is evident that the petitioner was minor at the time of acquisition.

The statement made in the writ petition that the land in question was running in the name of the petitioner and Thakor Laxmanji Mangaji (the petitioner herein) and Thakor Lakhaji Mangaji, who is one and the same person, is found to be absolutely false.
It is evident that the present petition has been filed with incorrect and incomplete facts and hence liable to be dismissed outrightly.
The writ petition is, dismissed accordingly.
